name: Incoming Gumdrop
summary: Talvash del Kissel keeps a Gnomeregan Gumdrop in Ironforge for a sick child in Stormwind. To earn it, you must give him a convincing train impression.

sections.title: A Whimsical Toll
sections.body: At Hallow’s End, trick-or-treaters visit the Alliance strongholds for treats. In Ironforge’s Mystic Ward, Talvash del Kissel keeps the Gnomeregan Gumdrop. He feels for the young orphan who hopes to receive it. Yet Talvash asks you to bring some mischief to the holiday with a convincing train impression.

sections.title: Holiday Charity
sections.body: Jesper is an ailing orphan in Stormwind City, hoping for four treats from across the Alliance. He wants nougat from Stormwind, a mint from Ironforge, marzipan from Darnassus, and a gumdrop from Gnomeregan. Your locomotive impression entertains Talvash and earns you the gumdrop. It brings Jesper closer to his holiday wish.

faq.q: What do I need to do to complete Incoming Gumdrop?
faq.answer: Give Talvash del Kissel a convincing train impression. Once he hears the noise, he hands you the Gnomeregan Gumdrop.
Talvash del Kissel is a gnome jeweler from Gnomeregan who lives in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward. During Hallow’s End, he gives Gnomeregan’s signature gumdrops to the Alliance.

faq.q: What is the Gnomeregan Gumdrop used for?
faq.answer: The Gnomeregan Gumdrop is one of four Hallow’s End treats gathered for Jesper, an orphan boy resting in Stormwind City’s orphanage.

faq.q: Where can Talvash del Kissel be found?
faq.answer: Talvash del Kissel can be found in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward.

faq.q: Why does Talvash make you imitate a train?
faq.answer: Hallow’s End brings trick-or-treating, and Talvash asks for a harmless trick before handing over his treat. He wants a locomotive impression.

aliases: can i do incoming gumdrop anytime
faq.answer: No. It is available only during Hallow’s End, the annual autumn festival.

angles.text: As a gnome in Tinker Town, offering a Gnomeregan Gumdrop during Hallow’s End can bring a cheerful reminder of home and mechanical ingenuity amid your people’s displacement.
As an Alliance hero, you travel through the kingdoms for a festival gumdrop, helping an ailing child in Stormwind share in the holiday.
